title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 229 ]

blocks.text: Some people feel that reading "for pleasure" (anything not directly connected to a job or immediately practical) is a waste of time. Spending hours with a book, they think, is unproductive dreaming. For example, when asked about their reading, some businessmen often reply, "I keep up with the professional literature, but I don't have time for books." Their tone implies that anyone with time to read book is somehow an idler.

readingSentences.english: Some people feel that reading "for pleasure" (anything not directly connected to a job or immediately practical) is a waste of time.
readingSentences.korean: 어떤 사람들은 ‘즐거움을 위한’ 독서(직업에 직접적으로 연관되어 있지 않은 것이나, 금방 실용화할 수 없는 것)는 시간 낭비라고 느낀다.

readingSentences.english: Spending hours with a book, they think, is unproductive dreaming.
readingSentences.korean: 그들이 생각하기에 책을 읽으며 몇 시간을 보낸다는 것은 비생산적인 꿈이다.

readingSentences.english: For example, when asked about their reading, some businessmen often reply, "I keep up with the professional literature, but I don't have time for books."
readingSentences.korean: 예를 들면, 그들은 독서에 대해 질문을 받을 때, 어떤 경영자들은 흔히 “나는 전문적인 서적에는 뒤쳐지지 않지만, 책을 읽을 시간이 없습니다.”라고 대답한다.

readingSentences.english: Their tone implies that anyone with time to read book is somehow an idler.
readingSentences.korean: 그들의 어조는 독서할 시간이 있는 사람은 어쨌든 한가한 사람이라는 것을 암시한다.
